verdict.rationale: The only documented programmatic pipeline-management surface is the Warehouse Sync API, which configures ingestion from Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery or Databricks into mParticle. That covers one kind of source. Connecting outputs is documented as a UI flow (Data Platform > Setup > Directory), and a Platform API is mentioned but its management scope is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented API for creating general inputs and destinations, wiring connections between them, inspecting delivery status, any MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can manage the pipeline itself — create sources and destinations, wire streams, inspect deliveries — through a documented API or MCP server

citations.quote: Warehouse Sync ingests data from your own warehouse into mParticle
with a Warehouse Sync API, SQL reference, and data mapping
